import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); print(sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))

# re-parse 6EAC chain A
cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6EAC.cif",timeout=180).text
L=cif.split("\n"); cols=[]; st=None
for i,ln in enumerate(L):
    if ln.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(ln.strip().split(".")[1])
    elif cols and not ln.startswith("_"): st=i; break
C=pd.DataFrame([f for ln in L[st:] if not ln.startswith("#") and ln.strip()
                for f in [ln.split()] if len(f)==len(cols)],columns=cols)
C=C[C['auth_asym_id']=='A'].copy()
C['num']=C['auth_seq_id'].astype(int); C['name']=C['auth_atom_id']
C['x']=C['Cartn_x'].astype(float); C['y']=C['Cartn_y'].astype(float); C['z']=C['Cartn_z'].astype(float)

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O13890-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
A=pd.DataFrame([dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),num=int(l[22:26]),
                     x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66]))
                for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")])
plddt=A.drop_duplicates('num').set_index('num')['b']

tip={'D':'OD2','N':'OD1','E':'OE1','K':'NZ','R':'NH2'}
pairmap={'D121':'D91','R123':'R93','K144':'K113','D156':'D125','E167':'E136','R208':'R176',
         'R215':'R183','D287':'D252','N288':'N253','D297':'D262'}
pairs=[('K144','E167'),('K144','D287'),('K144','D297'),('D287','N288'),('N288','D297'),
       ('K144','D156'),('D121','K144'),('R208','D287'),('R215','D287'),('D121','D297'),('R123','D297')]
def gat(df,n,a):
    s=df[(df['num']==n)&(df['name']==a)]; return s[['x','y','z']].values[0]
rows=[]
for a,b in pairs:
    da=float(np.linalg.norm(gat(A,int(a[1:]),tip[a[0]])-gat(A,int(b[1:]),tip[b[0]])))
    pa,pb=pairmap[a],pairmap[b]
    db=float(np.linalg.norm(gat(C,int(pa[1:]),tip[pa[0]])-gat(C,int(pb[1:]),tip[pb[0]])))
    rows.append({"sel0_pair":f"{a}-{b}","PsSelO_pair":f"{pa}-{pb}","sel0_AF2_A":round(da,2),
                 "PsSelO_6EAC_A":round(db,2),"delta_A":round(da-db,2),
                 "sel0_min_pLDDT":round(float(min(plddt[int(a[1:])],plddt[int(b[1:])])),1)})
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D.to_csv(f"{OUT}/table4_active_site_geometry.csv",index=False)
rP=float(np.corrcoef(D.sel0_AF2_A,D.PsSelO_6EAC_A)[0,1])
print("\nTABLE 4"); print(D.to_string(index=False))
print(f"Pearson r={rP:.3f}  median|delta|={D.delta_A.abs().median():.2f} A  max|delta|={D.delta_A.abs().max():.2f} A")

F=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/table3_fungal_selo_panel.csv")
okc=[c for c in F.columns if c.startswith("ok_")]
cons=F[okc].mean().mul(100)
ROLE={'D91':'Gly-rich loop Asp','R93':'Gly-loop Arg','K113':'VAIK Lys','D125':'Asp125 adenosine loop',
      'E136':'alphaC Glu','R176':'Arg176','R183':'Arg183','D252':'catalytic Asp','N253':'Asn Mg2+ ligand',
      'D262':'DFG-like Asp Mg2+'}
order=['D91','R93','K113','D125','E136','R176','R183','D252','N253','D262']

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,7.8))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=0.68,wspace=0.26)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
vals=[cons[f"ok_{o}"] for o in order]
ax.bar(range(10),vals,color=["#2E7D32" if v>=95 else "#F9A825" for v in vals])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1.6,f"{v:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(10)); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{o}\n{ROLE[o]}" for o in order],fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylim(0,115); ax.set_ylabel("% of 70 fungal orthologs")
ax.set_title("SelO active-site positions, defined here from AMP-PNP and Mg2+ contacts in PDB 6EAC,\n"
             "are near-invariant across 70 fungal genera; S. pombe sel0 retains 10 of 10",fontsize=11)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.scatter(D.PsSelO_6EAC_A,D.sel0_AF2_A,c="#1565C0",s=55,zorder=3)
lim=[0,float(D[['sel0_AF2_A','PsSelO_6EAC_A']].values.max())+2]
ax.plot(lim,lim,ls='--',c='grey')
for _,q in D.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(q.sel0_pair,(q.PsSelO_6EAC_A,q.sel0_AF2_A),fontsize=6.5,xytext=(4,-3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlim(lim); ax.set_ylim(lim)
ax.set_xlabel("PsSelO crystal 6EAC, side-chain tip distance (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("sel0 AlphaFold model (A)")
ax.set_title(f"Active-site geometry matches: r = {rP:.3f}, median offset {D.delta_A.abs().median():.2f} A",fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ax.plot(plddt.index,plddt.values,lw=0.8,c="#455A64")
for k in pairmap:
    n=int(k[1:]); ax.scatter([n],[plddt[n]],c="#C62828",s=24,zorder=5)
ax.axhline(90,ls=':',c='grey'); ax.set_ylim(0,105)
ax.set_xlabel("sel0 residue number"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("sel0 AlphaFold confidence (mean 95.8); catalytic residues in red",fontsize=10)
plt.show()
print("\nprovenance files:",sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))
